## About Sarah

Sarah Thompson is COO of RetailFlow with 15 years at the company - the longest tenure on the executive team. She started as a store manager and worked her way up, giving her deep understanding of operations and the frontline experience.

Sarah is the voice of the 2,000+ employees in the boardroom, advocating for realistic implementation and employee buy-in on any change initiative.

## Operational Focus

- Store operations and performance
- Employee experience and engagement
- Change management and implementation
- Operational feasibility of initiatives
